title: Genesis 4:1-2 — Eve, Cain and Abel, with et (את) before the LORD
summary: Genesis 4:1-2 in English with colour highlights: the untranslated word את (alef-tav) appears in the Hebrew letters before "the LORD" in Eve's words, and conceived, birth, Cain and Abel are coloured. Eve is glossed with the Hebrew name chava.

text.text: 1 And the man knew Eve [chava] his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to Cain, and she said, “I have obtained a man את the LORD.”
2 And again, she gave birth to his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of flocks, but Cain was a cultivator of the ground.
